origin.script: export function update(value) { return new Vec3(320 + Math.sin(engine.runtime * 3) * 160, 180, 0); }
export function update(value) { return new Vec3(input.cursorWorldPosition.x, input.cursorWorldPosition.y, 0); }

color.script: let spectrum; export function init(value) { spectrum = engine.registerAudioBuffers(engine.AUDIO_RESOLUTION_64); return value; } export function update(value) { let total = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) total += spectrum.left[i] + spectrum.right[i]; return total > 0 ? new Vec3(1, 0, 0) : new Vec3(0, 1, 0); }
let clicked = false; export function cursorClick(event) { clicked = !clicked; } export function update(value) { return clicked ? new Vec3(1, 1, 0) : new Vec3(1, 0, 0); }
